description: Image and chart updates. OCI compose files: Dependabot can't see them (it only recognises compose files by name, and these are named per app); deploys stay manual after a merge (task ansible:oci:apps or task ansible:oci:monitoring); BookOrbit's image is pinned in its compose file like the others. Cluster: image tags in kubernetes/apps and kubernetes/platform manifests, Helm chart versions in the ArgoCD Applications under kubernetes/cluster; ArgoCD deploys on merge. Dependabot keeps the DMZ compose file and GitHub Actions. kubernetes/bootstrap is applied by hand and isn't tracked.

packageRules.description: Cloud host (OCI) compose files. A new release waits 3 days before it gets a PR: these deploy outside ArgoCD, and fast-moving apps (BookOrbit ships weekly) sometimes follow a release with a fix
Kubernetes apiVersion suggestions are noise here; API moves are done by hand with the K3s upgrade
OCI patch and digest-only updates: one grouped weekly PR

Cloud host apps: patch, minor and digest updates merge themselves (squash) once CI is green and the 3-day wait is over. Merging deploys nothing on the cloud host: allowlisted apps ask on Telegram (Deploy / Skip), the rest wait for Ansible. Cluster updates stay manual, because merging there is an ArgoCD deploy.
Cloud host database images never merge themselves, even for a patch: they get their own PR so app updates are not held back by them
Cluster patch and digest-only updates: one grouped weekly PR (ArgoCD deploys it on merge)
Major updates wait for approval in the Dependency Dashboard issue (n8n 3, Postgres majors need migrations, chart majors change CRDs)
Database images: a major version needs a dump and restore, so never propose one automatically
K3s: one pull request for both pins; a minor version waits for approval (read the release notes, upgrade one minor at a time)
prBodyNotes: Merging does not upgrade the cluster. Follow `docs/runbooks/k3s-upgrade.md`: `task ansible:k3s:upgrade` in a quiet window.

customManagers.description: K3s release pinned in the cluster playbooks (5.59). Merging changes nothing on the cluster: run docs/runbooks/k3s-upgrade.md (task ansible:k3s:upgrade)
